g.text: Solid rays: fixed reference to state.
Blue starts at S; orange starts at G.
Dashed green: actual crossing to state.
The search fan uses the actual crossing;
buckets and radial pruning use S/G.
Actual Bitsailor search snapshots • constant 5 m/s boat speed • constant northerly wind • no land
Origin rays show selected states. All panels share the same scale; rays are not sailed tracks.
